# Operational Excellence / OEE Program

- **Goal / definition of done:** raise **blended network OEE from ~70% to the 85% target** and
  cut **scrap from 3.8% to under 2.5%**, restoring EBITDA margin toward 13%.
- **Owner:** [Sandra Kim](../people/sandra-kim.md) (COO); scrap stream owned by
  [Arjun Rao](../people/arjun-rao.md) (Quality).
- **Status:** in progress; Rockford (71% OEE) is the lead site and template; Toledo (63%) lags.
- **Why it matters:** this is the operating half of the margin-recovery story attached to the
  [First Meridian waiver](refinancing.md).

## Workstreams
- **Availability:** preventive-maintenance discipline to cut unplanned downtime.
- **Quality/scrap:** [Arjun Rao](../people/arjun-rao.md) traced pump scrap partly to porosity in
  **Cascade Castings** iron — links to the single-source supply issue.
- **Performance:** takt-time and changeover reduction on the pump lines.

## Open items
- Weekly OEE-by-plant report to [Howard Brandt](../people/howard-brandt.md) — see
  [commitments](../commitments.md).
